**NanoTeams is a free, open-source, local-first AI coding agent and multi-agent AI team app for macOS.** It runs 100% on-device through [Ollama](https://ollama.com) or [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai) — no cloud, no API keys, no subscription, no telemetry — so the local models you already run can read and edit your files, run git and Xcode, control the screen, and coordinate specialized AI roles inside a sandboxed work folder.
outcomeEvidence: Let an autonomous agent run the folder while you do something else. Give the **Autovisor** a goal and it watches your tasks, creates and schedules new ones, answers the questions roles would normally ask you, reviews finished work, and closes it, remembering what it learned along the way. It wakes when a task needs attention and idles when there's nothing to do. Message it any time to steer it, and a sleep timer (3 hours by default, adjustable in Settings) stops it so it can't run all night. Set its goal, memory, and schedule in Settings.

Two things worth knowing before you start a sweep. It **unloads your models** — both providers draw on the same memory, so everything is cleared, then each model is loaded, warmed up, and sampled alone; switch a server off to leave it untouched. And it takes **minutes per model**. The workload is one fixed prompt (~2,480 tokens in, capped at 512 out) with a fresh nonce each time so nothing is served from the server's prompt cache. Benchmarks never run while a task is running, and never switch your app onto the model being measured.

title: 代码变更验证与修复建议
frequency: 每次 PR / 发布
summary: 读取变更、运行既有校验、归纳失败原因，并产出可执行的修复建议。
agentLoop: PR 或构建失败触发 → 定位受影响文件 → 执行测试、lint 与类型检查 → 汇总证据 → 人工批准修复或合并。
successMetric: 减少人工排查时间；以首次通过率、回归缺陷率和平均修复时长衡量。
guardrail: 只运行仓库允许的命令；不得自动合并、发布或修改生产配置。

title: 客服工单分流与升级
frequency: 持续、高并发
summary: 识别意图、紧急程度和账户上下文，将工单路由至正确队列并准备回复草稿。
agentLoop: 新工单进入 → 提取主题与风险信号 → 分类、去重、补全上下文 → 分派或生成草稿 → 人工发送与抽检。
successMetric: 缩短首次响应时间，提升一次解决率并降低错误升级率。
guardrail: 涉及退款、隐私、法律或安全事件时必须升级人工；Agent 不直接承诺补偿。

title: 安全告警证据归并与初步调查
frequency: 持续监控
summary: 把分散的告警、日志和资产信息归并为可审阅的调查包，帮助分析师优先处理高风险事件。
agentLoop: 告警触发 → 拉取允许范围内的上下文 → 关联相似事件与资产 → 生成证据时间线 → 安全分析师裁决。
successMetric: 缩短平均分诊时间，提高有效告警占比与调查证据完整度。
guardrail: 仅只读访问获授权的数据源；不得自行隔离资产、封禁账号或删除证据。

title: 文档转结构化业务流程
frequency: 每次政策、合同或流程更新
summary: 从规范、合同或操作手册中提取字段、步骤、例外和待确认项，生成可审阅的结构化工作项。
agentLoop: 上传或更新文档 → 提取关键字段和规则 → 标出不确定项与引用位置 → 人工确认 → 写入目标系统。
successMetric: 降低录入耗时与遗漏率，衡量字段准确率和人工修改率。
guardrail: 保留来源页码与引用；合同解释、法律结论和最终写入必须由授权人员确认。

title: 销售账户研究与会前准备
frequency: 每次重点会面
summary: 从获授权的 CRM、公开资料和历史互动中整理账户背景、机会、风险和建议问题。
agentLoop: 会议创建 → 汇总允许的数据源 → 生成带来源的简报与提问建议 → 销售确认 → 用于会前准备。
successMetric: 提高准备覆盖率、跟进及时率和有效会议转化率。
guardrail: 不得从非授权来源抓取个人数据；简报不得替代 CRM 中的人工事实核验。

title: 数据质量异常定位与修复提案
frequency: 每次数据管道运行
summary: 发现异常、追溯上游变更、估计影响范围，并生成可复现的修复建议。
agentLoop: 质量规则失败 → 对比历史与上游变更 → 生成异常说明、影响范围和修复 SQL 草案 → 数据负责人审核执行。
successMetric: 缩短异常恢复时间，降低重复故障与错误数据影响范围。
guardrail: Agent 只能读取生产数据并在隔离环境生成建议；写操作必须由数据负责人批准。

title: 浏览器后台操作与异常交接
frequency: 高频、规则明确
summary: 在权限受控的后台系统中完成查找、录入和状态更新，并在异常或高风险动作前暂停。
agentLoop: 合格请求触发 → 导航至已授权系统 → 读取与填写字段 → 校验结果 → 低风险操作执行，高风险操作请求确认。
successMetric: 减少单笔处理时长，追踪成功率、人工接管率和返工率。
guardrail: 支付、删除、对外发送和权限变更必须二次确认；每一步保留审计日志。

title: 会议纪要到行动项闭环
frequency: 每次关键会议
summary: 将会议记录整理为决策、负责人、截止时间、依赖关系和待澄清事项。
agentLoop: 会议结束 → 提取行动项与引用片段 → 指派建议负责人 → 参会者确认 → 同步至项目管理系统。
successMetric: 提升行动项确认率、按时完成率与会后跟进速度。
guardrail: 参会者确认前不应把推断的承诺或负责人写入正式系统。

The industry has caught on to what agent-native developers already knew: the unit of AI-assisted work isn't the prompt, it's the **loop** — act, verify, correct, go again. Models write better prompts than we do now; the scarce skill is designing the loop that keeps agents pointed at the goal, and the verifier that decides whether the work is actually done.
outcomeEvidence: The Flywheel is the part most tools don't have. It doesn't run tasks — it runs **revolutions**: every pass around the loop either ships the work or surfaces a defect that gets filed and fixed. It's the loop that improves the loop, and it's how most of Overdeck itself gets built.

- **The right model for every phase.** A frontier model plans the architecture, faster models write the code and handle mechanical steps. Overdeck routes automatically — or you override with two clicks when you know better.
sceneEvidence: Multi-agent orchestration for AI coding assistants

One agent or twenty, hands-on or hands-off: spawn agents on real issues, watch every diff land live, steer mid-task, and let a built-in specialist pipeline review, test, and merge the work — while you decide exactly how much of the loop runs without you.

taskEvidence: Self-hosted, model-agnostic AI teammates in Slack. Agents with their own @handle, memory, skills, and per-channel permissions. 35 connector presets (Zendesk, Stripe, GitHub, HubSpot), MCP and API connections, scheduled work, coding sandbox. Manage from Slack, Admin, or MCP. Built on Flue. Cloudflare Workers or Node. MIT.

Chickpea gives your team AI teammates in Slack. You address them by name. `@support` answers the billing question in the channel where someone asked it. `@revops` posts Monday's pipeline numbers from HubSpot on a schedule. `@oncall` reads the repo before it answers. Each one has its own instructions, memory, connected accounts, and list of channels it's allowed to work in. You set all of that up by asking, in Slack.
outcomeEvidence: Every run rechecks the whole chain: is the Agent alive, does it still have the channel, is the creator still a member, do the required connections still work, does policy still allow it. If authority disappears, future runs pause. Chickpea never silently reassigns work to someone else. Cloudflare supplies alarms; the production Node launcher checks for due work at startup and every minute while its process is running.

Install the coding sandbox when an Agent needs a real checkout, package installation, tests, or a dev server. Open **Settings → Coding sandbox**, request installation, redeploy. It requires **Workers Paid**. The container application and its Ubuntu-based image live in your Cloudflare account and may incur costs on it, and the first image build takes several minutes. Node installations always use the standard in-memory bash sandbox and never touch the host filesystem or host git and SSH. Full procedure in the [coding sandbox runbook](docs/runbooks/coding-sandbox-deployment.md).
sceneEvidence: 4. **The reply lands in the thread under `@support`'s name and avatar,** streamed as it's written. The thread now belongs to `@support`. Anyone in the channel can follow up there without mentioning it again, and mentioning `@finance` in the same thread hands the work over in the open.

Publishing to a public channel joins the bot automatically. Private channels need someone to `/invite @Chickpea` first, and the grant stays pending until then. Where an Agent is published also decides who can DM it. In a public channel, any workspace member can. Only in private channels, only those members can. Unpublished, only its creator can.

taskEvidence: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Upload-Post — publish, schedule, analyze and manage social media from any MCP-compatible AI agent.

Lets any MCP-compatible AI agent (ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, …) publish, schedule, analyze and manage social media across **TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Reddit, Bluesky, X, Google Business, Discord, Telegram and more** with a single API key.
outcomeEvidence: `get_media` and `get_cached_post_analytics` are cursor-paginated: feed the response's `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until `has_more` is false. LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram do not support media cursors and accept `limit` only. Prefer `get_cached_post_analytics` over `get_post_analytics` when scanning many posts — it replays previously fetched results and so avoids the live analytics rate limit of 100 requests / 5 minutes. Only contains posts previously fetched through a live per-post endpoint; there is no background refresh, so captured_at is the last time that post was read live.

The staging object is deleted after 24 hours whether it is used or not. Scheduled/queued posts remain safe because `upload_video` copies the temporary URL into the existing durable scheduler storage before execution.
sceneEvidence: Upload-Post is a reviewed app in the **ChatGPT app directory**. [Add Upload-Post in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a1fed02ff5c8191b4060c5807221f26) — or search for *Upload-Post* under **Apps** — click **Connect** and sign in with OAuth. No Developer mode, no MCP URL to paste, and you get the [Upload Studio](#chatgpt-video-upload-ui) widget for publishing video files straight from your computer.

- `get_post_analytics` — per-post metrics. `post_metrics` is whatever the platform reports, so its shape varies: on TikTok it adds `retention`, `impression_sources`, `audience_types`, `new_followers`, `reach` and the watch times (`average_time_watched`, `total_time_watched`, `full_video_watched_rate`).
